editorial:
Imagine having a perfect life on paper, only to watch it all fall apart in a matter of days. You follow Gleb, a big-shot boss who seems to have everything under control until the walls start closing in. Between the stress of his job and the shock of finding out his wife is cheating on him, he starts to snap. The movie feels like a slow-motion car crash that you just can't look away from. It captures that feeling of panic when you realize you can't fix your problems with money or power anymore, and the tension builds up until it finally boils over into something scary.

The acting is top-notch, and you can really feel Gleb's frustration in every scene. While some parts of the story move a bit slow, the payoff at the end is totally worth the wait. If you love stories about people losing their cool, you need to see this. For the best experience, you should stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video to catch all the gritty details. If you are a movie collector, adding the 4K Blu-ray to your physical collection is a great move because the picture quality is stunning.
endingExplained: In the final scenes, Gleb completely loses his grip on reality. He tries to kill his wife's lover, but he ends up trapped in his own home, mirroring a maze. The big twist is that Gleb had already lost his job weeks ago, and he was just pretending to go to work. He ends up arrested and alone, realizing that his obsession with control was the very thing that destroyed his entire life.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves psychological thrillers and stories about corporate greed.
